log.notes_to_self: Day 1 killed 7: national/forum, foreign/forum, foreign, forum, forum/East twice, forum. All quick afternoon: compatible routines night workers, students, home (55%); keep afternoon-only to avoid further routine narrowing. Strategy concentrate on forum/foreign and national; East+forum adds no constraint once forum established. Avoid radio-only and blotter-only: additional independent demographic constraints could push pool <=1000. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible to L, unknown. First new feedback after day 3. Target >=30 deaths per rolling 5 days, ideally >=40 if safe sources allow. No evidence yet about inaccessible records.
